title: prd-coverage contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-257). The SHAPE of the PRD product-done verdict that `faff prdr coverage` PRODUCES and `faff contract prd-coverage` VALIDATES (consumer-side conformance, mirroring prdr-yagni / prdr-admission). It carries two faces of one goal↔PRDR↔DoD relation: the LOWER (coverage) gate FAFF-255 delegates to — `covered` / `uncovered_goals`, the static 'every PRD goal stays covered by a live PRDR' check, fed to `prdr admit --lower` — AND the `prd-satisfied` roll-up: `satisfied` is true only when coverage holds AND every live PRDR's DoD is `met` per the FAFF-34 evaluator (the dynamic completion half). The completion verdict reads FAFF-34's per-PRDR verdicts with a CONSERVATIVE default — a PRDR with no `met` verdict (evaluator absent/unbuilt) is unverified, so `satisfied` is false (never falsely done). NO safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it, so a malformed extraction is a fail-loud. Load-bearing invariants (covered ⟺ no uncovered goals; satisfied ⟹ covered ∧ all DoDs met; not-satisfied carries a reason) are enforced in code as conformance violations. `prd-satisfied` is product-done; FAFF-38 composes it with ledger-clean into run-done, FAFF-259's release-gate Done consumes it per-project. FAFF-496 §3a adds the OPTIONAL, additive `measure {total_goals, covered_goals}` block (observability + the reserved home of a future ratio-tolerance knob) — the producer (`faff prdr coverage`) emits it, it changes NO existing covered/satisfied/completion semantics, and the run-START trigger (`faff run-start`) reads `.covered`, never `.measure`.
